description: This Java class configures JMS worker components within the Apache Fineract project, setting up listener container factories and message listener containers for processing JMS messages related to batch jobs.

classes.name: JmsWorkerConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for setting up JMS listener containers and message listeners in a Spring context, conditionally enabled based on the presence of JmsWorkerCondition.

methods.name: jmsBatchWorkerListenerContainerFactory
methods.description: Creates a configured DefaultJmsListenerContainerFactory for JMS batch worker listening with specified concurrency and session modes.

methods.name: jmsBatchWorkerMessageListenerContainer
methods.description: Creates a DefaultMessageListenerContainer bound to a specific JMS destination, using the provided factory and message listener.
